managers.name: Ines Vance
managers.bio: High press, high line. Took Copperfield from the second tier to 8th, then left in May.

managers.name: Augustin Peverell
managers.bio: Deep block and counters. Kept Fogbury up three seasons running on a small budget.

managers.name: Tamsin Reedwick
managers.bio: Fast, direct football. Best goals-per-game record of any manager in the league last season.
